subject: Morpha
text: Morpha deals about one heart worth of damage if a tentacle lands on Link, and upwards of three hearts if a tentacle grabs hold of him.

evidence.quote: If one of them lands on you, you take about one heart worth of damage, but if one of them grabs hold of you, it can deal upwards of three hearts, this attack is very powerful!

subject: Morpha
text: Firing the Longshot near the end of a tentacle pulls Morpha out of the water and leaves it open to sword attacks.

evidence.quote: Take aim near the end of the tentacle with your Longshot and fire at Morpha to suck it out of the water and leave it open to attack.

subject: Lake Hylia
text: Using the Longshot to hook to the tree top at Lake Hylia, walking to the end of the branch, and turning around allows Link to claim Gold Skulltula 074.

evidence.quote: Use it to hook onto the top and pull yourself up so that you land on the long branch.  There is a Gold Skulltula here beside you but you cannot get it from here, cross the branch to the end and turn around.  Use your Longshot to aim at it and claim the GOLD SKULLTULA [074].

subject: Lake Hylia
text: Shooting the morning sun with the Fairy Bow right after the morning cock-a-doodle-doo when the lake water rises causes the Fire Arrow to descend.

evidence.quote: It says that when the water in the Lake Rises, aim for the morning sun.  Do as it says, just after you hear the cock-a-doodle-doo of morning, take aim with your Fairy Bow and fire up at the sun.  When you do, a special item will descend down from above.  Swim over and pick up the FIRE ARROW.

subject: Hyrule Castle
text: Playing the Song of Storms by the isolated tree south of the castle garden entrance reveals a secret hole with three bombable walls concealing Gold Skulltula 075.

evidence.quote: South of this place there is a large tree which stands by itself, stand beside it and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up) to reveal a secret hole.  Drop down this hole and bomb all three weak walls here.  Behind one of them you will find a GOLD SKULLTULA [075].

subject: Zora's River
text: Playing the Song of Storms while standing on the log in front of the frogs in Zora's River rewards Piece of Heart 029.

evidence.quote: Stand on this log and play the Song of Storms (A, down, up, A, down, up) to have them give you a PIECE OF HEART [029] as a reward.

subject: Zora's River
text: Playing the Song of Time while standing on the log in front of the frogs in Zora's River causes them to give Link a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: After doing this stay where you are an play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and they will pop up again to give you a PURPLE RUPEE.

subject: Zora's River
text: Completing the grown frogs minigame with the button sequence A, left, right, down, left, right, down, A, down, A, down, right, left, A rewards Piece of Heart 030.

evidence.quote: The solution is as follows: (A, left, right, down, left, right, down, A, down, A, down, right, left, A).  Doing this will net you a reward, the PIECE OF HEART [030].

subject: Windmill
text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the windmill shack accelerates the windmill and drains the water from the well.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Storms in there (A, down, up, A, down, up) and it will cause the windmill to speed up, draining the water out of the well.

subject: Triforce symbol
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby while standing on the Triforce symbol lowers the water level in the Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote: At the other end you will find a Triforce symbol on the ground, stand on it and pull out your Ocarina.  Play Zelda's Lullaby while standing on this thing to lower the water level.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Dropping into the hole near the entrance room reveals a small chest containing Bombs.

evidence.quote: Return to the entrance of this room and drop down the hole, open the small chest to acquire some BOMBS and then crawl into the crawlspace.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Defeating the Dead Hand miniboss reveals a large chest containing the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: After the miniboss is defeated, open the large chest to acquire the LENS OF TRUTH.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Hidden doors down the halls to the left and right in the main room lead to two chests that both contain a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Check both left and right of this just a couple steps down the halls in both directions to find other hidden doors leading to two chests which both contain SMALL KEY.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Passing through the hidden door on the right along the left hall leads to a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Follow the hall around the corner and through the hidden door on the right to find a large chest containing the COMPASS.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Heading down the hall past the two orange flame torches and through the rocks leads to a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: When you reach the middle here, collect as many Silver Rupees as you possibly can and then go down the hall past the two orange flame torches and through the rocks to find a large chest with the DUNGEON MAP in it.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Jumping down in front of the gate along the left hallway leads to a small chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Half way down this hallway make another left and move toward the gate, then jump down in front of it.  Open the small chest here to get a RECOVERY HEART and then climb the vines behind the chest.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Lighting the torches beside the coffins with Deku Sticks reveals a Small Key inside one of the coffins.

evidence.quote: After doing that whip out the Deku Sticks (remember those) and light the torches beside the coffins.  You'll get a lot of bats flying at you but one of them will contain another SMALL KEY.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Inside the corner jail cell of the middle area is a small chest containing a Deku Nut.

evidence.quote: When you get in here, check the one jail cell in the corner for a small chest containing DEKU NUT.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Defeating the flower and possessed urns behind the northwest locked door allows Link to collect Gold Skulltula 076 using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Open the locked door on the northwest side, defeat the flower and the possessed urns and then use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [076].

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Following the perimeter edge path using the Lens of Truth in the northeast room allows Link to retrieve Gold Skulltula 077 using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Equip the Lens of Truth to see the path going around the edge.  Walk along this path and use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [077].

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Opening the small chest in the room beyond the northeast crawlspace yields a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Open the small chest here to get a BLUE RUPEE and then go through the door.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Defeating the blob monster reveals Gold Skulltula 078 on the wall to claim with the Boomerang, alongside a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: In this room quickly defeat the disgusting blob monster and then use your Boomerang to get the GOLD SKULLTULA [078] from the wall, there is also another BLUE RUPEE in the treasure chest.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Bombing the cracked lump past the hole on the left at the north end of the main room reveals a small chest with a Deku Nut inside.

evidence.quote: You can pass the hole on the left and then bomb that weird lump wit ha crack in it to reveal a small chest with a DEKU NUT inside.

subject: Hyrule Market
text: Paying 10 Rupees to play the night treasure chest minigame in Hyrule Market and using the Lens of Truth to choose the key chest five consecutive times rewards Piece of Heart 031.

evidence.quote: Speak to the man and give him the 10 Rupees he wants in order to play the game then use the DOOR KEY you get to enter the next room.  There are two chests here and you have to guess the correct one.  This is easy, simply equip the Lens of Truth and open the chest with the key now, and four more times after this.  Your reward for cheating is the PIECE OF HEART [031]

subject: Water Temple
